features: Detector confidence, log box aspect/area relative to image, nearest detected person foot distance relative to person height, ball/person height ratio. No labels, IDs, game clocks, pixels or tracking ground truth enter features.
training_targets: Maximum ball-reference IoU >=0.5 positive, <=0.1 negative, intermediate overlaps ignored. Frame without ball annotation excluded from fitting but retained in descriptive full-frame evaluation.
selection: Choose highest pooled box F1 among candidates satisfying gates separately for each validation mode; tie break retained matches then fewer unmatched predictions. Include keep-all and confidence-only baselines. Use one-to-one matching at IoU 0.5.
acceptance: For each mode, retain >=95 percent of keep-all matched boxes and reduce unmatched predictions >=20 percent. Freeze candidate before scoring game 9; repeat same gates there. If either stage fails, do not integrate.
limits: Short previously exposed training clips. Box matching is not in-play ball identity or possession correctness. Empty references may be incomplete. No camera fusion validation. Recheck does not permit retuning this experiment.
